_note: PLACEHOLDER: replace names, wants and fears with your own lore. Used from Phase 4.
_tiers: Wave 6a (2026-10-18): the five decided tiers (mission_brainstorm.md). pay_mult: what that faction pays at that tier (Proposed; docs/wave6_groundwork.md). Hostile offers no work.
_rules: Wave 6a, all Proposed: ripple (a share of any rep change goes to the faction's allies, the opposite to its enemies), decay (rep drifts toward neutral by decay_per_day once decay_grace_days pass without a job; allied_grace_days for an Allied faction), and side lockout (taking a faction's contract locks you out of its enemies' work for lockout_days, counted again from the debrief).
_kits: Wave 6b (2026-10-18): what each enemy faction fields, by kit id (a faction's "kit"). body + one entry of guns by mix (a team, wave or garrison's i-th man gets mix[i % size]) + tail; roles casts a gun's carrier (Roles); variant is his camo (VoxelArt.VARIANTS). "insurgent" and "pmc" are Black Ridge's and Vantage's (CompoundLevel.hostile_loadout / rival_pmc_loadout, kept in code: Vantage's exo gear by difficulty lives there). Regional armies fight with what we have: the AK/PK/SVD family stands in until regional weapon art (Chinese, Iranian) lands.
